title: Homogeneous solutions of the stationary Navier-Stokes equations in arbitrary dimension
summary: For every integer $n\ge4$, we prove the existence of a $(-1)$-homogeneous solution of the stationary incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on $\mathbb{R}^n\setminus\{0\}$ with an arbitrary locally Lipschitz $(-3)$-homogeneous force. The pressure is $(-2)$-homogeneous, and the solution is regular away from the origin. This extends the homogeneous existence theorem of Bang, Gui, Liu, Wang, and Xie beyond dimension sixteen.
